summary: Implemented the Jupyter utilities feature. Added monai/utils/jupyter_utils.py with is_jupyter() (detects a ZMQ notebook shell without importing IPython) and plot_image_grid() (matplotlib grid of 2D images, matplotlib imported lazily, no optional_import). Added tests/test_jupyter_utils.py: the 4 is_jupyter tests pass; the 3 plot_image_grid tests are skipped because matplotlib is not installed in the shared venv, so the plotting code is unverified. Added a "Jupyter" automodule section to docs/source/utils.rst. Nothing committed, no packages installed. The module is not re-exported from monai/utils/__init__.py.
